raw.rationale: Cepharanthine is a bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid with broad, pleiotropic cytotoxicity (NF-kB inhibition, calcium/ROS effects, P-gp modulation) and no established lineage-selective dependency at 2.5 µM in PRISM; published PRISM/CTRP data show mostly non-selective killing, so probabilities are near the low base rate with slight elevation for NF-kB-dependent lymphoid/myeloma lines not present here and for transporter/efflux-influenced lineages.
